_meta.audience: Climate Series A — strategic and financial investors

data.title: Carbon removal is finally a market
data.body: Voluntary carbon markets crossed $2B in 2024 and the IRA-equivalent credits in MENA are finally pricing permanence at the level DAC needs.

data.title: A sorbent tuned for the desert
data.body: Our metal-organic-framework sorbent regenerates at 90°C — well below the wet-bulb threshold — and pulls CO₂ at $180/ton today, on a path to under $80.

data.title: Raising $25M Series A
data.body: To commission two 10,000 t/yr plants and to lock in 10-year offtake agreements with regional cement and steel producers.
